serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: Good evening, were you talking about me?
Detective: Yes. This unlucky guy was waiting here for a whole day and we are just closing up. Could you look through his stuff?
Policewoman: It’s not a part of my duties to-
Detective: Oh come on, don’t be like that, it will only take a minute! You came before your shift anyway.
#Policewoman.Face.annoyed
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: Alright. I will do it. 
Detective: That’s the spirit! See ya!
